desc: Derive the linearity/contribution formula and the O(MN) recurrence plan for the product polynomial.
Implement digit-length counts c_l and sums S_l for l=1..6.
Implement D(z) and B(z) for active digit lengths and the O(MN) recurrence for p[0..N] of P(z).
Implement factorial weights a_k=k!(N-1-k)! and per-length division q_k=p_k-10^l q_{k-1} to compute F_l.
Combine answer ∑S_l F_l modulo 998244353, handle N=1, and verify samples plus small brute-force cases.
